evals.name: go-single-package
evals.prompt: I have to change how printgateway parses printer addresses and I never opened that code. Explain src/printgateway/internal/printer to me so I really understand it.
evals.expected_output: A published code map (Map, Walkthrough, Simulator, Files) for internal/printer, narrated, in code mode.
assertions: prepare.py --code sizes the scope (SMALL) and the build exits 0 with 0 unresolved refs
the walkthrough explains every in-scope code file and every code module (coverage line)
no beat anchor is missing from its excerpt (no 'not in the excerpt shown' warning)
2-4 scenarios, each entering from a real caller of the package (ref resolves outside the scope)
the page is in code mode: meta.mode = code, no +/- counts, no Commits tab
every narration line has a recorded Kokoro clip (voice: N of N)

evals.name: vcpp-class-p4
evals.prompt: Explain the SendByRest class in AutocommLib (labOS VC++, MainRls). I'm going to own it.
evals.expected_output: A code map for SendByRest.h/.cpp with its callers as context modules, excerpts cut at each ClOwner::Method definition, synced CL shown.
assertions: the build exits 0 with 0 unresolved refs
walkthrough refs use 'SendByRest.cpp → <Class>::<Method>' and every excerpt starts at the definition line, not a call site
callers outside the class (e.g. DownloadMessagesManager) appear as context modules with real edges
meta.version names the synced CL; no diff_base
the maintenance checklist names the guarding unit test (UT_SendByRest) where it applies

evals.name: go-library-medium
evals.prompt: I'm taking over the CUPS queue library in printer-server (src/printgateway/internal/cups). Help me understand how it works end to end, I need to maintain it.
evals.expected_output: A code map for internal/cups built with the MEDIUM staffing (sonnet inventory, one tracer, one story writer), narrated.
assertions: the build exits 0 with 0 unresolved refs
the walkthrough explains at least 80% of in-scope code files and every code module
4-8 scenarios covering the main path, the repeat (queue already exists) and at least one failure
no beat anchor is missing from its excerpt
every narration line has a recorded Kokoro clip

evals.name: script-smoke
assertions: both selftests print PASS

evals.name: stakeholder-brief
evals.prompt: I need to explain the print gateway (src/printgateway) to the stakeholders for a risk review - give me something I can present.
evals.expected_output: The code map gains a Brief tab (first; the page still opens on Map): what the area does for the business, why it exists, how it works (system + 1-3 major flows), risk and takeaways; no before/after slide.
assertions: deck.json builds with exit 0 and prints the deck line with 0 lint
no before_after slide; 1-3 flow slides tied to real scenario ids
every slide and reveal step carries a speaker note
without deck.json the build output and page data are identical to the pre-change engine
